ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with dominant low-intensity (black) surface area (~85%) and localized high-intensity (white) ring-shaped features (~15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogenous low-intensity field across both lobes, overlaid with discrete, non-contiguous high-intensity circular and elliptical ring-shaped blobs concentrated in the central and upper-mid regions of the visible fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate 70-degree internal angle relative to the horizontal plane of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Relatively smooth linear boundary along the superior edge with low-amplitude stochastic undulations; no distinct repetitive serration patterns visible at current resolution.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-symmetrical outward expansion with a marked upward concavity ending in acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple clusters of high-contrast white circular and semi-circular ring patterns (rosettes) distributed across the entire dark-pigmented surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface of both fluke lobes.
